patterns.title: Zero-Trust app_metadata RLS, Customer-vs-Operator Isolation & Zero Secret Leaks
patterns.standard_playbook: Audit every migration for app_metadata-only RLS with regex-guarded bigint casts, verify x-api-key/JWT gates on operational endpoints, enforce customer-vs-operator Flex Card separation, and scan all source/learning files for credentials.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Never trust user_metadata in RLS, never expose operator Approve/Reject postbacks in customer groups, and block any payload containing tokens, keys, or raw private keys.

patterns.title: Non-Destructive Live RLS Policy Evolution & Zero-Warning Supabase Security Posture
patterns.standard_playbook: Evolve live production RLS policies in-place with ALTER POLICY using server-signed app_metadata and regex-guarded bigint casts, run RPCs as SECURITY INVOKER where service_role/RLS permits, and verify 0 ERROR / 0 WARN on Supabase Security Advisor.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Never use destructive DROP/TRUNCATE on live production learning or tenant tables, and never leave any Security Advisor ERROR or WARN unresolved.
